oracle.method: R parse() builds the AST; a walk over R's own AST collects file-level bindings (no evaluation, so no stubs and no unevaluated files)

note: R's own parser and AST decide which names a file binds; the analyzer decides the same question with tree-sitter-r; the answers are compared. Precision 1.0 / recall 1.0 means every binding R reports is published and no binding is published that R does not make. `declarationsNotBindings` counts S4/S7 registrations, which declare a class or generic without binding a variable of that name - a different fact from a variable binding, so it is reported rather than scored.
